entities.summary: Jack Dann is an American writer best known for his science fiction, as well as an editor and a writing teacher, who has lived in Australia since 1994. He has published over seventy books, the majority being as editor or co-editor of story anthologies in the science fiction, fantasy and horror genres. He has published nine novels, numerous shorter works of fiction, essays, and poetry, and his books have been translated into thirteen languages. historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prolific editor and writer of science fiction anthologies, Jack Dann has played a significant role in shaping the genre's narrative landscape, particularly in the Australian literary scene. His work has been translated into thirteen languages, demonstrating his impact on global popular culture.
